mapper.insert: insert into attendance(employee_id, work_date, check_in_time, check_out_time, status) values (#{employeeId}, #{workDate}, #{checkInTime}, #{checkOutTime}, #{status})
mapper.select: select id, employee_id, work_date, check_in_time, check_out_time, status from attendance order by work_date desc, employee_id asc limit #{offset}, #{size}
select id, employee_id, work_date, check_in_time, check_out_time, status from attendance where employee_id = #{employeeId} order by work_date desc
select count(*) from attendance where work_date = #{workDate}
